title: OPEC+ ministerial meeting (November quotas)
source: EST: opec.org/pr-detail/1835613-6-september-2026.html — the seven participating countries' own release, re-fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200), which records that they 'decided to maintain September 2026 required production for October 2026' and closes with the verbatim sentence 'The next meeting will be held on 4 October 2026.' Corroborated independently by Rigzone (2026-09-07, per-country October targets) and EnergyConnects (2026-09, 'scheduled for 4 October, when members are expected to reassess market conditions'). Filed estimate on two counts that are both about the taxonomy, not the evidence: market-events-data.ts defines no trusted source prefix for opec.org, so EST: is the honest label even against the group's own statement, and this lane may not self-confirm an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Canonical entry written by this event's own never-assessed initial research (2026-09-08), reconciling two sibling proposals that agreed on every field: proposals/opec-plus-meeting-2026-10-04.from-opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06.json (the 09-06 close-out) and .from-treasury-3y-note-2026-09-08.json (that auction's D-0 sweep). 2026-10-04 is a TWO-BODY DAY and the calendar tracked only the advisory half: opec-jmmc-68th-2026-10-04 (`low`) is the Joint Ministerial Monitoring Committee, which monitors DoC conformity and RECOMMENDS; THIS entry is the seven-country voluntary group — Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, Oman — which actually sets the quota. Impact `medium` mirrors opec-plus-meeting-2026-09-06 and reflects the base case (a second consecutive non-decision, November sitting inside the reported Q4 pause), not the consequence if the signal breaks. What makes this instance structurally different from its predecessor: the third-party Maximum-Sustainable-Capacity audits that set every member's 2027 baseline run January-September 2026, so 10-04 is the FIRST OPEC+ forum at which every baseline number exists — and Iran's 2027 baseline is being fixed off its own August-October 2026 production while its exports are collapsed. The monthly number is priced; the baseline fight is the tail. Cadence now 6 for 6 on the record (06-07, 07-05, 08-02, 09-06, 10-04 each named verbatim in the prior release, monthly on Sundays), and the 09-06 release states the seven will continue to hold monthly meetings.
